description.narrative:
The fund will support our two partners under the DEC response, namely Palestinian Environmental Friends (PEF) and Palestinian Agricultural Development Association (PARC) with emergency financial support that will be used for operational and duty of care costs arising from the current situation. Both partners suffered substantial damages to their offices in Gaza and are in the urgent needs of an unrestricted and flexible funding that is not attached to the project costs and can be used to cover essential needs such as repair work, rental of the new premises, purchase of office assets etc. This is not exhaustive list as needs of the two partners are much higher, but this DoC fund will definitely contribute to rebuilding their operational capacity and will alleviate the burden on them and financial stress that usually comes from the administrative restrictions related to the % allocations that NGOs can usually allocate to the support/operational costs.
Partner staff: Palestinian Environmental Friends (PEF) Palestinian Agricultural Development Association (PARC) With an equal split in the financial allocation
While more donors are being open to cover the essential duty of care under current horrific circumstances that our staff and partners were and still to and extend going through, and do understand the gravity of the issue as well as grow to understand that the current cumbersome bureaucratic procedures are not fit anymore inthe context of Gaza, the changes are happening slowly and not at the pace that is required. This DEC proposed duty of care and well-being of staff fund will allow us to disburse the funds rapidly and flexibly. Moreover, with this small yet impactful grant, we will be able to continue prioritizing service delivery to the population of concern, which is our outmost priority, while making sure that we can also in parallel support the essential needs of our partners who are the frontline of the response.
It should be noted that with our own unrestricted resources, we have launched a Partner Investment Fund initiative back in September to specifically support our partners with emergency fund. This fund, while able to support 8 partners with an amount of approx. 15,000 EUR) is limited in its’s scope and cannot nearly meet the needs of the partners nor the number of the partners that require urgent support, hence additional financial contribution from DEC would allow us to cover more partners, including PARC and PEF under this Duty of Care fund.

participating-org.narrative: The Palestinian Environmental Friends Association is a non-profit organization (Nongovernmental Organization). It was establishmentin 1998 by a group of Palestinian experts to meet the demand needed in the field of the environment and natural resources.The establishment of PEF enables environmental friends all over the world to cooperate neglecting geological and political constrains to stopthe negative impacts on the environment. Together, we create a universal free from pollution, sustainable and suitable for new generations. PEF practiced projects almost all over Gaza Strip. The projects activities mainly covered the following areas: Water and wastewater, public health, global warming, infrastructure and capacity building activities, compost production, solid wastes and awareness programs. The association aim is to share in improving the environmental situation in the Palestinian territories, also, to protect the local environment, and public health natural resources from pollution and mining. Public awareness <(>&<)> environmental education is one of the organization aims to have sustainable and well-managed natural resources in addition of rehabilitation of Water and Sewerage Infrastructure in Northern Gaza Governorate .
